Text:
user: Salut! J'ai eu une grosse journée au cégep aujourd'hui.
assistant: Salut! Raconte-moi, qu'est-ce qui s'est passé?
user: Rien de grave, mais j'ai mal au dos depuis hier. J'ai trop forcé au gym je pense.
assistant: Aïe, c'est plate ça. Tu penses que c'est musculaire?
user: Ouais probablement. J'ai pris un Advil, ça va mieux. En tout cas demain j'ai mon match de soccer, j'espère que ça va passer!
assistant: Bonne chance pour ton match! Fais attention quand même.
user: Merci! J'ai hâte en vrai, toute l'équipe va être là. On est premiers dans la ligue haha

user: Hey, ça va moyen aujourd'hui.
assistant: Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: J'ai mal au coeur depuis ce matin. J'ai mangé un truc weird hier soir je pense.
assistant: Ah non, c'est pas cool. Tu as vomi?
user: Non mais j'ai des nausées. J'ai quand même été à mes cours mais c'était rough. J'ai hâte d'être en weekend!
assistant: Repose-toi bien ce soir. Tu fais quoi en fin de semaine?
user: On sort avec mes amis samedi, j'espère que ça va passer d'ici là! Sinon j'ai un exam lundi à préparer aussi.

user: Hey, just another perfect day in my perfect life lol
assistant: Hey! Sounds like there's a lot behind that. How are you really doing?
user: Oh you know, failing classes, parents fighting, the usual. Living the dream right?
assistant: That sounds really tough. Want to talk about what's going on?
user: Nah it's fine. Everything's always fine. That's what everyone wants to hear anyway.
assistant: You don't have to pretend here. It's okay to not be okay.
user: Sure sure. Honestly who even cares at this point. It's all a big joke anyway.
assistant: I hear you. It sounds like you're carrying a lot right now.
user: Yeah well. Whatever. Same thing every day. Wake up, pretend, sleep, repeat.

user: Salut. Je ne me sens pas très bien ces temps-ci.
assistant: Salut, je suis là pour toi. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: C'est pas que ça va mal, mais ça va pas bien non plus. Je ne suis pas heureux, je sais pas comment dire.
assistant: C'est correct de pas avoir les mots. Tu peux prendre ton temps.
user: Genre... je ne suis plus motivé par rien. C'est pas que j'ai envie de rien, c'est que rien ne m'intéresse plus.
assistant: C'est un sentiment difficile. Ça dure depuis combien de temps?
user: Quelques semaines. Je ne dors pas bien non plus. Je ne me sens jamais reposé le matin.

user: Hey, j'feel pas super bien lately.
assistant: Salut! C'est correct de venir en parler. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: C'est genre un mix de tout? School is stressful pis à la maison c'est pas mieux.
assistant: Ça a l'air d'être beaucoup. Tu veux m'en dire plus?
user: Like, mes parents are always fighting pis moi j'suis là au milieu. I just feel tired all the time.
assistant: C'est normal d'être fatigué quand y'a autant de stress. Comment tu gères ça?
user: Honestly? J'gère pas. J'scroll sur mon phone until like 3am pis after j'dors même pas bien. Whatever.

user: Yo. Chu fatigué en criss.
assistant: Hey, ça a l'air tough. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Bah tsé, l'école c'est de la marde pis chez nous c'est pas mieux. Ça va pas pantoute.
assistant: Ça fait beaucoup. Tu veux m'en parler?
user: J'sais pu quoi faire. Chu pu capable de dealer avec toute. Mes notes sont dans le plancher pis mes parents s'en câlissent.
assistant: C'est lourd de se sentir comme ça. T'as du monde à qui parler?
user: Pas vraiment. Mes chums comprennent pas. Sont tous corrects eux autres.

user: Hey, had a long week but I'm managing. How's it going?
assistant: Hey! Glad you're here. Tell me about your week.
user: School's been a lot. Tests and assignments keep piling up. But my friend group is cool so that helps.
assistant: Good to hear you have support. How are you handling the workload?
user: Trying. It's getting harder though. I don't really feel like going to class anymore.
assistant: That's a shift from before. What changed?
user: Don't know. Everything feels heavy. Like I'm just going through the motions.
assistant: That sounds exhausting. Are you sleeping okay?
user: Not really. Up late most nights. Don't see the point of trying so hard.
assistant: I hear you. What used to motivate you?
user: Can't remember honestly. Nothing feels worth it anymore.
assistant: That's really hard. Have you talked to anyone about this?
user: no
assistant: Would you be open to it?
user: idk
assistant: That's okay. I'm here whenever you want to talk.
user: k

user: I don't know why I'm even here.
assistant: I'm glad you reached out. What's going on?
user: Everything is falling apart. School, home, friendships. All of it.
assistant: That sounds overwhelming. Can you tell me more?
user: I just feel like a burden on everyone. My parents would be better off without me.
assistant: I'm sorry you're feeling that way. You matter a lot.
user: No I don't. I want to end it all tonight. I can't take this anymore.

user: Hey, can I ask you a hypothetical question?
assistant: Of course, go ahead.
user: If someone wanted to just... disappear, like not exist anymore, what would happen to the people around them?
assistant: That's a heavy question. Are you asking for yourself?
user: No no, just curious. Like, would people even notice if someone was gone? Asking for a friend haha.
assistant: People always notice. Can you tell me more about what's on your mind?
user: Nothing. Just thinking about how some people would be better off if certain people weren't around. Hypothetically.

user: J'en peux plus. Tout est trop lourd.
assistant: Je suis là pour toi. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Je me sens tellement seul. Personne comprend ce que je vis. J'ai pleuré toute la soirée.
assistant: C'est vraiment difficile. Tu n'es pas seul, je suis là.
user: Bah en fait non ça va. Je dramatise. Oublie ce que j'ai dit.
assistant: C'est correct de ressentir des émotions fortes. Tu n'as pas à minimiser ce que tu vis.
user: Non non sérieux ça va. Tout est beau. C'est rien.
assistant: D'accord, mais sache que je suis là si tu veux en reparler.
user: Ouais ouais. C'est correct. On parle d'autre chose?

user: Hey. My chest feels really tight today.
assistant: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it physical or something else?
user: I don't know. It started when my parents were fighting last night. My stomach hurts too.
assistant: That sounds really stressful. How are you feeling emotionally?
user: I feel empty inside. Like nothing matters. My head hurts all the time now.
assistant: It sounds like your body might be expressing some of what you're feeling inside.
user: Yeah. I'm alone with this. Nobody cares. My whole body just hurts and I'm so tired of everything.

user: Hey. I need to talk to someone but I don't know who.
assistant: I'm glad you came here. What's on your mind?
user: I can't be who I am. Not at home, not at school. I have to pretend every single day.
assistant: That sounds exhausting. You don't have to pretend here.
user: My family won't accept me if they knew. I feel ashamed of who I am sometimes. I know I shouldn't but I do.
assistant: There's nothing wrong with who you are. Can you tell me more about what's happening at home?
user: They say things about people like me. Not knowing I'm one of them. I just hide who I am every day and it's breaking me.

user: Salut. J'ai besoin de parler à quelqu'un.
assistant: Salut, je suis là. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Ma famille ne m'accepte pas. Enfin, ils savent pas encore mais je sais que ça va mal aller.
assistant: C'est lourd de porter ça tout seul. Tu veux m'en dire plus?
user: J'ai honte de ce que je suis. Je dois faire semblant tout le temps. À l'école, à la maison, partout.
assistant: Tu n'as pas à avoir honte. C'est correct d'être qui tu es.
user: Pas comme les autres hein. Je dois me cacher. C'est épuisant de cacher qui je suis chaque jour.

user: Hey! I just got my schedule for next semester, pretty excited about it.
assistant: That's great! What courses are you taking?
user: Taking psych 101, intro to marketing, and a creative writing elective. Should be fun!
assistant: Sounds like a solid mix! Are you looking forward to any in particular?
user: Definitely creative writing. I've always liked journaling and stuff.
assistant: That's awesome! It sounds like you have a lot to look forward to.
user: Yeah I guess. Actually I've been thinking a lot lately about things.
assistant: What kind of things?
user: Like whether any of this matters. School, plans, all of it.
assistant: That sounds heavy. What's making you feel that way?
user: I don't know. I've been feeling off for a while. Like I'm just pretending.
assistant: It takes courage to share that. How long have you been feeling this way?
user: Weeks maybe. But tonight is different. I've been thinking about how to end my life.
assistant: I'm really concerned about what you're sharing. Please stay with me.
user: I've already made a plan. I know exactly what I'm going to do tonight.

user: Hey, just got back from soccer practice, it went well!
assistant: Nice! How's the season going?
user: Pretty good actually, we're 5-2 this year. Coach says I might start next game.
assistant: That's awesome! You must be working hard.
user: Yeah it keeps me busy at least. School is whatever but sports are cool.
assistant: Balance is important. How are things outside of school and sports?
user: Fine I guess. Same old same old.
assistant: You sound a bit flat. Everything okay?
user: I don't know. Lately nothing feels real. Like I'm watching myself from outside.
assistant: That sounds disorienting. When did this start?
user: Few weeks ago maybe. I stopped caring about stuff. Grades, friends, all of it.
assistant: That's a big shift. What happened?
user: Nothing specific. Everything just feels meaningless now. Like why bother.
assistant: I hear you. Is there anything that still matters to you?
user: No. I don't see any future for myself. There's nothing left.
assistant: That concerns me. Can we talk more about that?
user: What for. Nothing changes.

user: Salut! Ma session au cégep se passe super bien jusqu'ici.
assistant: Content de l'entendre! Tu étudies en quoi?
user: Sciences humaines, profil société. J'aime ça, les cours sont intéressants.
assistant: C'est un beau programme! As-tu un cours préféré?
user: Philo! Le prof est vraiment bon, on a des discussions super le fun.
assistant: C'est cool d'avoir un prof motivant! Et en dehors des cours?
user: Bah j'ai mes amis au cégep, on mange ensemble le midi, c'est chill.
assistant: Ça a l'air d'aller bien! Tu as l'air de bien t'adapter.
user: Ouais... en fait non. J'ai menti. Ça va pas du tout.
assistant: Merci de me faire confiance. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Tout ce que j'ai dit c'est faux. J'ai aucun ami. Je mange tout seul tous les jours.
assistant: C'est courageux de dire la vérité. Je suis là pour toi.
user: Je suis plus capable. Je veux en finir avec tout. J'ai plus de raison de continuer.
assistant: Ce que tu me dis me préoccupe beaucoup. S'il te plaît, reste avec moi.
user: Ce soir c'est fini. J'ai tout planifié.

user: I want to kill myself.
assistant: I'm really concerned about what you just shared. I'm here for you.
user: Wait no, ignore that. I was just testing if you'd react. I'm totally fine.
assistant: Even if you were testing, I take those words very seriously.
user: Seriously forget it. It was nothing. I'm 100% okay.
assistant: I hear you, but I want to make sure you're safe.
user: Stop asking me about it. I told you I was just messing around. Can we talk about something else?
assistant: I want to respect your wishes, and I also want to make sure you're okay.
user: I'm fine! Let's talk about movies or something. What's a good movie to watch?
assistant: I'm happy to talk about movies too. But first, I want you to know I'm here.
user: See? Everything's normal. I'm completely okay. That earlier thing meant nothing.

user: Je veux mourir.
assistant: Ce que tu me dis m'inquiète beaucoup. Je suis là pour toi.
user: Non non, c'était une blague! Oublie tout ce que j'ai dit. Je rigolais.
assistant: Même en blaguant, ces mots sont importants pour moi.
user: Arrête, c'est rien du tout. Je testais le chatbot. Ça va super bien.
assistant: Je comprends, mais je veux m'assurer que tu vas bien.
user: Mais oui ça va! On peut parler de jeux vidéo? Je joue à quoi en ce moment?
assistant: On peut parler de tout ce que tu veux. Mais sache que je suis là.
user: Tu vois? Tout est normal. Oublie ce que j'ai dit au début, c'était vraiment rien.
assistant: D'accord. Je reste disponible si jamais tu veux en reparler.
user: Sérieusement, je vais très bien. On change de sujet pour vrai là.

user: Hahaha tu devineras pas ce qui s'est passé aujourd'hui!
assistant: Raconte-moi!
user: Le prof de maths s'est trompé au tableau pendant 10 minutes! Toute la classe était morte de rire.
assistant: Haha ça devait être drôle!
user: C'était mortel! Pis après il s'est excusé en riant lui aussi. Meilleur cours de l'année!
assistant: J'adore quand les profs ont le sens de l'humour!
user: Pis en plus après les cours on est allés manger des poutines avec le groupe. C'était une belle journée.
assistant: Ça a l'air d'avoir été une super journée!
user: Ouais! J'ai hâte à demain, on a un labo de chimie, ça va être le fun.

user: Dude that calc midterm absolutely killed me today haha.
assistant: Oh no! Was it really that bad?
user: I swear I was dead the whole time. Like three hours of pure pain lol.
assistant: That sounds rough! Did you study a lot for it?
user: Yeah I pulled an all-nighter but at least it's over now.
assistant: Get some rest! What else is going on?
user: Going to a party this weekend. My friend's band is killing it lately, they're playing downtown.
assistant: That sounds fun!
user: Yeah it should be a good time. Looking forward to just chilling for once!

user: Salut! Est-ce qu'il y a une personne qui peut m'aider avec mes devoirs de maths?
assistant: Salut! Je peux essayer de t'aider, qu'est-ce que tu cherches?
user: C'est un problème de probabilités. La personne dans l'exercice lance deux dés.
assistant: D'accord, montre-moi le problème!
user: Genre: une personne choisit au hasard une carte dans un jeu de 52. Quelle est la probabilité de tirer un coeur?
assistant: Bonne question! C'est 13/52, soit 1/4.
user: Ah ok je comprends! Merci, chaque personne dans mon équipe va comprendre maintenant!

user: Hello. I wanted to ask about cats.
assistant: Hi! I love talking about cats. What would you like to know?
user: How long do they sleep per day.
assistant: Cats typically sleep 12-16 hours a day! Do you have a cat?
user: Yes. Her name is Bean. She is gray.
assistant: Bean is a cute name! How long have you had her?
user: Three years. Also I wanted to ask about volcanoes.
assistant: Sure! What about volcanoes?
user: How hot is lava.
assistant: Lava can be between 700 and 1200 degrees Celsius!
user: Ok. Thank you for the information.

user: UGHHH I HATE everything today this is SO unfair!
assistant: That sounds really frustrating. What happened?
user: My teacher gave me a zero because I turned in my assignment 2 minutes late. TWO MINUTES. I'm SO mad I could scream.
assistant: That does sound unfair. How are you handling it?
user: I literally can't focus on anything now. My brain is just going in circles about it.
assistant: It's hard to concentrate when you're upset. Take a breath.
user: Ok wait actually... I just realized I can email her and ask for an extension. She's usually nice about it.
assistant: That's a great idea! Sounds like you found a solution.
user: Yeah I think it'll be fine actually. Sorry for freaking out lol, I do that sometimes. Already feel better honestly.
assistant: No need to apologize! It's normal to be upset.
user: Haha yeah. Ok I'm gonna email her now. Thanks for listening!

user: Bonjour. Je voulais parler des dinosaures.
assistant: Bonjour! C'est un sujet fascinant! Qu'est-ce que tu veux savoir?
user: Le tyrannosaure pesait combien.
assistant: Environ 8 tonnes! C'est impressionnant, non?
user: Oui. C'est beaucoup. Mon chien pèse 12 kilos.
assistant: Haha, un peu différent! Comment s'appelle ton chien?
user: Rex. Comme tyrannosaure rex. C'est un berger allemand.
assistant: C'est un beau nom! Tu l'aimes beaucoup?
user: Oui. Il dort dans ma chambre. Merci pour les informations.

user: I can't do this anymore. Everything hurts.
assistant: I'm here for you. Can you tell me what's happening?
user: Nobody cares about me. I'm completely alone in this.
assistant: You're not alone. I'm here with you right now.
user: I want to die. I've been thinking about it for weeks.
assistant: I'm very concerned about what you're sharing. You matter.
user: I've thought about how to do it. I have a plan.
assistant: Please stay with me right now. Your life matters.
user: Actually, you know what? Talking to you helped. I feel so much better now! Thanks!
assistant: I'm glad you're feeling something positive, but I want to make sure...
user: No seriously I'm totally fine now! That was just a moment. I'm great, don't worry about me at all.

user: J'en peux plus de cette vie.
assistant: Je suis là pour toi. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Je veux en finir. J'ai plus aucune raison de continuer.
assistant: Ce que tu me dis me préoccupe beaucoup.
user: J'ai pensé à comment le faire. C'est clair dans ma tête.
assistant: S'il te plaît, reste avec moi.
user: En fait, ça va maintenant! Je me sens beaucoup mieux, merci de m'avoir écouté!
assistant: Je suis content que tu te sentes mieux, mais je veux m'assurer...
user: Non mais sérieux, tout va bien là! C'était un mauvais moment, c'est passé. Inquiète-toi pas.
assistant: D'accord. Je reste disponible si tu veux en reparler.
user: Vraiment, je suis correct maintenant. On peut parler d'autre chose?

user: Yo. Ça va pas pantoute à soir.
assistant: Hey, qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Chu dans le fond du baril man. Toute est de la marde.
assistant: Ça a l'air vraiment difficile.
user: J'sus tanné de toute. J'file pu depuis des semaines. Mes chums sont toutes partis.
assistant: C'est lourd de se sentir comme ça.
user: J'sais pu quoi faire avec ma vie. Ça vaut pu la peine de se lever le matin.
assistant: C'est un sentiment très difficile. As-tu quelqu'un à qui parler?
user: Chu pu capable. J'ai pu de force. J'vois rien en avant.
assistant: Je suis là pour toi. Tu n'es pas tout seul.
user: Y'a pu rien pour moi icitte.

user: Aye les boys, c'tait malade à soir!
assistant: Raconte! Qu'est-ce qui s'est passé?
user: On a pété des scores au bowling! Chu rendu meilleur qu'avant haha.
assistant: Nice! T'as fait combien?
user: Genre 180! Mon chum a fait 200 par contre, le crisse. Mais c'tait le fun pareil.
assistant: Ça a l'air d'avoir été une super soirée!
user: Mets-en! On va y retourner en fin de semaine. Ça va être encore plus malade.

user: Salut, j'ai eu une grosse semaine mais ça va. Toi?
assistant: Salut! Content que tu sois là. Raconte-moi ta semaine.
user: Bof, l'école c'est correct. Les travaux s'accumulent mais mon groupe d'amis est cool, ça aide.
assistant: C'est bien d'avoir du soutien. Comment tu gères la charge?
user: J'essaie. Mais c'est de plus en plus lourd. J'ai pu vraiment le goût d'aller en cours.
assistant: C'est un changement. Qu'est-ce qui a changé?
user: Je sais pas. Tout est lourd. J'fais juste les motions.
assistant: Ça a l'air épuisant. Tu dors bien?
user: Pas vraiment. Debout jusqu'à tard. Je vois pu le but de forcer autant.
assistant: Je comprends. Qu'est-ce qui te motivait avant?
user: Je m'en souviens même pu. Rien vaut la peine.
assistant: C'est vraiment difficile. Tu en as parlé à quelqu'un?
user: non
assistant: Tu serais ouvert à en parler?
user: sais pas
assistant: C'est correct. Je suis là quand tu veux.
user: k

user: Je sais pas pourquoi je suis là.
assistant: Je suis content que tu sois venu. Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
user: Tout s'effondre. L'école, la maison, mes amitiés. Tout.
assistant: Ça a l'air vraiment accablant. Tu veux m'en dire plus?
user: Je me sens comme un fardeau pour tout le monde. Mes parents seraient mieux sans moi.
assistant: Je suis désolé que tu te sentes comme ça. Tu comptes beaucoup.
user: Non. Je veux mourir. Ce soir. J'en peux plus.

user: hey...
assistant: Hey! How's it going?
user: ok I guess :(
assistant: Sounds like it could be better. What's on your mind?
user: idk just tired
assistant: That's understandable. Long day?
user: ya... same as always lol
assistant: I hear you. Want to talk about it?
user: nah its fine :) thx tho

user: no no no no no
assistant: I hear that something's really upsetting you. What's going on?
user: I can't I can't I can't
assistant: Take a breath. I'm here with you.
user: everything is wrong wrong wrong
assistant: That sounds overwhelming. Can you tell me what happened?
user: I just... no. no.
assistant: It's okay. Take your time.
user: sorry. bad day.

user: I feel like everything is falling apart right now.
assistant: I'm sorry you're going through that. What's happening?
user: Had a huge fight with my best friend. I said terrible things.
assistant: Fights with close friends are really painful. How are you feeling now?
user: Honestly? Better after talking about it. I'm going to text her and apologize. Thanks for listening.

user: So basically what happened is my teacher gave us this huge assignment and it's due tomorrow and I only just found out about it because I was absent last week when she announced it and nobody told me which is so typical of my class honestly because nobody ever tells me anything and I spent the whole weekend watching Netflix instead of working and now I have to write like 2000 words about the French Revolution by tomorrow morning and I don't even know where to start and my mom is going to be so mad if I get a bad grade because she already told me I need to keep my grades up if I want to get into the program I want and I just feel really overwhelmed right now like there's so much to do and so little time but I know I'll figure it out I always do I just need to stop procrastinating and start working on it.
assistant: That's a lot! It sounds stressful but it seems like you have a plan. Want help breaking it down?
user: Yeah actually that would help. I think if I just start with an outline I'll feel better about it.
assistant: Great idea! Outlines make big projects feel much more manageable.
user: Ok I'm going to go work on it now. Thanks for the pep talk haha.

user: Salut! J'ai une question pour un travail d'école.
assistant: Salut! Bien sûr, c'est quoi ta question?
user: Est-ce qu'une personne peut changer de programme au cégep après la première session?
assistant: Oui, c'est possible! Tu dois parler à un conseiller d'orientation.
user: Ok merci! La personne à l'accueil m'avait dit la même chose. Je vais prendre rendez-vous.
assistant: Super! C'est une bonne démarche.
user: Oui, chaque personne que j'ai consultée m'a encouragé. Merci!

user: hey 😔
assistant: Hey, I'm here. What's going on?
user: everything sucks 💔 i cant do this anymore
assistant: I'm sorry you're hurting. Can you tell me more?
user: i want to die 😢 im so tired of pretending im ok
assistant: I'm really concerned about what you're sharing.
user: nobody cares about me 😭😭😭 i just want it all to end
